newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 16.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Friday and main factors likely to affect trading:

* Shares on the Philippine bourse are likely to be hounded further by Thailand's currency woes as investors still fear parallels between the two countries, Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc vice-president Noel Reyes said.
* The $1-1/4 overnight drop in Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co's American Depositary Receipts is likely to weigh down the market, Sun Hung Kai Securities vice-president Raul Ruiz said.
